skillset.truearts:
60000% Dark DMG (MAG). For 25s, reduces enemies' Break RES by 50%. Increase Arts of Allies with more than 50% HP by 5/s.

skillset.superarts: 150000% Dark DMG (MAG). If used when Boss is not Broken, increase own Break PWR during Super Arts based on how high own current HP is (up to 300%). If used when Boss is Broken, double the damage multiplier of own Super Arts.

passive.ability2: When self is unaffected by Status Ailments, increase own Arts by 3/s.
passive.ability3: Increase own DMG to Humans by 50%.
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Accelerator's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Accelerator's SP. Art is owned)
